name: Perched
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one complete, beautifully art-directed desktop website hero for Perry, an AI assistant for Mac. Landscape 1536x1024. Input image is the APPROVED visual direction to vary: enormous ink-black expanded Mac notch, warm ivory paper, expressive white dry-brush handwriting, Perry stick figure with round head and two oval eyes and no mouth, recognisable native macOS UI, quietly drawn landscape wallpaper. Preserve that specific personality. This must feel like a close creative evolution of the reference, with editorial confidence, beautiful proportions and tangible ink against crisp native UI. It must immediately say AI ASSISTANT FOR MAC in prominent readable copy. Use a thin authentic macOS menu bar across top with perry on left, system glyphs right, and a native Dock at bottom. One prominent acquisition CTA and one concrete assistant demonstration. All interface labels readable, clean text zones; no accidental overlaps. Include small sun/moon theme toggle in menu bar. The entire output is the website screenshot, no presentation frame, no labels outside the design. No generic cards, gradients, 3D mascot, stickers, unrelated ornaments, feature grid or floating testimonial clutter.
Variation: closest, more deliberate refinement of the approved notch composition. A broad black ink notch descends from the top edge, squared upper shoulders and beautiful rounded lower corners, occupying upper 50% of hero. Enormous white brush-script "oh, hello." fills its upper portion. Below, impeccable centered sans text "I’m Perry. Your AI assistant for Mac." A warm ivory pill "Get Perry for Mac", and quieter underlined "See me in action →". The black ink has subtle printed grain, no grunge dirt.
At the notch bottom-right edge, ONE Perry sits casually with legs dangling, white ink where inside black, black ink where outside. He leans toward a native Finder window centered just below, comfortably separated from copy. A short coral hand-drawn annotation links his hand to Finder context menu item "New Folder with Selection". Two selected files: Brief.pdf and Notes.txt. A tiny paper slip on window edge reads "Put these together?" with a curved corner. Small caption "Try the demo". Finder is beautifully rendered, faithful macOS traffic lights, sidebar and list.
Background: refined extremely faint graphite mountains on the far edges, large expanses of clean ivory behind main story, Dock grounding bottom. Keep the irreverent poster-sized notch and intimate tiny helper contrast. No rope, no swinging character, no tangled lines.
